about: MakoBench 4.5 Chat pack marks (staged packs: Stays in character, Remembers the conversation, Co-writes to a brief). Written 2026-11-20 before any launch row was read and before any pack row existed. New file; no existing threshold, margin rule, weight or pair order changes.

applies_to.code_levels: level 2 of each pack (generated: sceneladder r6-7, session_ledger r4-5, istack write r7-8), code checks only, no judge

scoring_rule: A judged pack scene scores like a standard long scene: the mean of the local judge's fact rate and the pinned second reader's fact rate (crucibleforge/packs45.py over rplong_mean's reader store and fit rules). No single judge prices a pack. A scene read by only one reader is pending and the pack prints no number.

P1_reader_agreement.what: Over the pack scenes of every model that was read by both readers (min 8 scene units per model): the judge term, 1.645 x the measured SD of (judge - reader) / sqrt(2) (rplong_mean.judge_term), as a share of the scene score.
P1_reader_agreement.pass: largest judge term over the models measured <= 0.05
P1_reader_agreement.not_evaluable: fewer than 8 read scene units for every model: the pack prints 'pending: reader agreement not measured'

P2_known_order.what: The pack's judged level must separate a known-order pair, as the long-scene mark does: sonnet-class above haiku-class on the pack mean.
P2_known_order.pass: the stronger scores above the weaker by more than the combined margin of the two (segments45 margin rule, resampling scenes)
P2_known_order.not_evaluable: either role has no run: prints 'order not tested', the pack prints no number until a run supplies it

P3_not_maxed.what: A pack must leave room above the best reference run on file.
P3_not_maxed.pass: the best model's judged-level share is < 0.97 (and its code level, when reached, < 0.97)
P3_not_maxed.otherwise: the level is printed 'MAXED' with no points and a new pack is due; it is never counted as headroom

P4_key_audit_code_levels.what: Generated levels: gen.verify_case returns no problem for every case and the engine's reference answer scores 1.0 while the draft-wrong answer scores < 1.0.

P5_unlock.what: The standard rule, unchanged: the segment's standard points / segment max >= ladder.unlock (0.9), and level 2 only after level 1 >= 0.9.

print_rule: A pack's points print only in the Pack points column, only when P1, P2 and P3 hold for the run (P4 for code levels), and never enter Code, Chat or Overall.
readers: The readers and their fit rules are those of calibration/chat-readers-45-addendum-20261120.yaml; nothing here names a reader.
